messages:
neha: noticing a surge of mTLS failures in ap-southeast, clients hitting "no_certificate" errors
peter: saw alerts ~1767038888, load balancer logs show SNI mismatch and several certs failing to decrypt
sec-bot: ALERT: mTLS-handshake-fail ap-southeast (count=112)
zane: rotator shows KMS:Decrypt returned AccessDenied for keystore-role when trying to unwrap chain-anchor alias
neha: did anyone touch KMS alias mappings or keystore role scope overnight?
deploy-bot: deploy 17670 -> keystore-mapper applied to ap-east and ap-southeast at 1767035400 by ci/bot
liz: ops: we rolled an alias migration script that swapped alias/main-kms -> alias/new-kms but didn't update the keystore mapping config for ap-southeast
peter: so proxies in ap-southeast still request old alias, KMS policy only allows new-kms alias for keystore-role -> decrypt denied
zane: yep KMS logs show conditional Deny: "Principal keystore-role not allowed for alias/main-kms" from nodes with tag cluster=ap-southeast-legacy
ops-bot: recommended immediate action: restore keystore-role access to alias/main-kms for ap-southeast or rollback alias swap
neha: prefer temporary access grant with TTL while we run re-encryption migration. less service impact
peter: agree, grant with 4h TTL then run backfill to re-encrypt certs under new-kms and update mapping
liz: I'm patching IAM now: iamctl grant --principal keystore-role --alias alias/main-kms --region ap-southeast --ttl 4h
sec-bot: ACTION: temporary KMS alias grant applied by liz at 1767039123
zane: rotator logs show KMSDecrypt OK after grant, cert chains loading, handshake errors dropping
peter: schedule for region migration: 1) find certs still encrypted with alias/main-kms 2) re-encrypt under alias/new-kms 3) update keystore mapping 4) run canary
neha: I'll run detection job to list cert owners and region buckets. script will post results to /runbooks/keystore-migration
ops-bot: archive snapshot of current keystore state to s3://redwood-incident-archive/1767038888-sni-keystore-snapshot
deploy-bot: note: rollout history for keystore-mapper at /rollouts/17670
liz: follow-ups assigned:
 - neha: region detection job and owner contact list
 - zane: add preflight CI check that validates alias mapping per region before alias swaps
 - peter: coord re-encryption sweep with cert owners
 - sec-team: add alert rule: KMSDecrypt Deny > 3 in 1m for any region
neha: scheduling 20m postmortem in 30m, will capture timeline and remediation steps
sec-bot: INCIDENT TAGS: security.high, compliance.audit_collected
peter: once migration is done revoke the temporary grant and verify no KMSDecrypt denies
neha: leaving temp grant active until migration completes, will update when revoked
liz: creating GH PR to add region-aware alias mapping test and link to incident
sec-bot: ALERT CLEARED at 1767040200
